SAMPLE - fictitious document. Not a real insurance contract.
ENDORSEMENT SM 40 03
ADDITIONAL INSURED - OWNERS, LESSEES OR CONTRACTORS
SCHEDULE
Endorsement Number | 3
Policy Number | SAMPLE-CGL-2026-0001
Named Insured | Example Contractors LLC
Endorsement Effective Date | 03/15/2026
Additional Insured | Example Property Holdings LLC
Location of Covered Operations | 200 Sample Avenue, Sampletown, ST 00000
Additional Premium | $350
This endorsement changes the policy. Please read it carefully. It modifies the insurance provided under the Commercial General Liability Coverage Form.
A. Who Is an Insured is amended to include as an additional insured the person or organization shown in the Schedule, but only with respect to liability for bodily injury or property damage caused, in whole or in part, by your acts or omissions, or by the acts or omissions of those acting on your behalf, in the performance of your ongoing operations for the additional insured at the location shown in the Schedule.
B. The insurance provided to the additional insured applies only to the extent permitted by law. If a written contract requires you to provide this coverage, the insurance provided to the additional insured will not be broader than the coverage that the contract requires.
C. This insurance does not apply to bodily injury or property damage that occurs after all work on the project, other than service, maintenance or repairs, has been completed at the location shown in the Schedule, or after the part of your work out of which the injury or damage arises has been put to its intended use by any person or organization other than another contractor on the same project.
D. The most we will pay on behalf of the additional insured is the amount required by the written contract or the amount available under the Limits of Insurance shown in the Declarations, whichever is less. This endorsement does not increase the Limits of Insurance.
E. The additional insured must give us written notice of an occurrence as soon as practicable, and must send us copies of any demand, notice, summons or legal paper received in connection with a claim or suit. The additional insured must also tender the defence of the claim to any other insurer that provides coverage to it for the same loss.
F. Primary and Noncontributory. If a written contract requires it, this insurance is primary to and will not seek contribution from any other insurance available to the additional insured, provided that the additional insured is a Named Insured under that other insurance.
G. Waiver of Transfer of Rights. We waive any right of recovery we may have against the additional insured because of payments we make for injury or damage arising out of your ongoing operations at the location shown in the Schedule, where a written contract requires the waiver.
